# WhatsApp production template

Create and approve one utility template in WhatsApp Manager.

Suggested template name: `abutron_system_alert`
Language: `en_US`

Suggested body:

ABUTRON JARVIS ALERT
Severity: {{1}}
{{2}}
{{3}}
Reference: {{4}}

RC1-09 supplies these four variables:
1. severity
2. title
3. summary/body
4. incident/approval reference

Keep the template operational/utility in nature. RC1-09 does not send marketing content.
